- get_employee_list: Cost: 3 credits / employee returned.
- hellosign_send_signature_request: Signatures. Made simple.

I need to send our standard NDA to everyone currently working at https://www.linkedin.com/company/vertex-global-logistics. Please pull their full profile data to get email addresses and process the signature requests using the document at /documents/compliance/nda_q4_2024.pdf.

The tool retrieved 3 employee profiles containing verified work and alternate contact emails. This confirms we have the necessary information to distribute the NDA to Marcus Thorne, Sarah Jenkins, and David Chen. I will now initiate the signature requests using all email addresses found in the records.
